_note: One line per skill, as Jev sees it. Exact duplicates (engineering:* vs anthropic-skills:*) are merged; load_as is the name passed to the Skill tool.

file-reading.line: Open an uploaded file whose content isn't shown yet; routes by file type (pdf, docx, xlsx, csv, json, images, archives).

pdf-reading.line: Read or extract text, tables, images or form fields from an existing PDF.

pdf.line: Create, merge, split, rotate, watermark, fill, encrypt or OCR PDF files.

docx.line: Create or edit a Microsoft Word .docx file when Word format is explicitly wanted.

pptx.line: Create, read or edit a PowerPoint .pptx file when PowerPoint format is explicitly wanted.

xlsx.line: Create, clean, edit or convert spreadsheet files (.xlsx, .csv, .tsv).

docs.line: Create a shareable, editable document (report, proposal, letter, guide, resume) when no file format is named.

google-workspace.line: Create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in the user's Google Drive.

product-self-knowledge.line: Facts about Anthropic products: Claude Code, Claude API, claude.ai plans, pricing and limits.

frontend-design.line: Visual design direction for a new or reworked web UI: typography, layout, aesthetics.

typesafe-ai.line: Build software features that use TypeSafe/Jev typed judgments (routing, ranking, extraction).

jev-sort.line: Classify, score or triage a pile of text items using Jev.

jev-router.line: Turn the Jev model router on or off, or show its status.

architecture.line: Write or review an architecture decision record (ADR) choosing between technologies.

system-design.line: Design a system, service, API or data model from requirements.

code-review.line: Review a code change, PR or diff for bugs, security and performance.

debug.line: Debug an error, stack trace or unexpected behavior: reproduce, isolate, fix.

testing-strategy.line: Plan what tests to write and how to structure test coverage.

test-driven-development.line: Implement a feature or bugfix test-first: failing test, then code.

tech-debt.line: Audit and prioritize technical debt and refactoring work.

code-structure.line: Refactor duplicated logic across workflows into shared actions or services.

documentation.line: Write technical documentation: README, API docs, runbook, onboarding guide.

deploy-checklist.line: Pre-release checklist before deploying to production.

incident-response.line: Handle a production incident: triage, status updates, postmortem.

standup.line: Write a daily standup update from recent work.

kubernetes-health-check.line: Check Kubernetes cluster health before deploying.

sql-queries.line: Write or optimize SQL queries for a database or data warehouse.

writing-plans.line: Write a step-by-step implementation plan for a coding task before building.

executing-plans.line: Carry out an existing written implementation plan in batches.

brainstorming.line: Explore a raw idea or feature through questions before implementing it.

dataviz.line: Make any chart, graph, plot or dashboard.

artifact-design.line: Design guidance before building a published web page artifact.

artifact-diagramming.line: Draw a diagram inside a web page artifact.

artifact-capabilities.line: Give a web page artifact live data, shared state, storage or forms.

drawio-reconstruction.line: Turn a diagram image or screenshot into an editable draw.io file.

figure-designer.line: Design the figures for a research paper: motivating example, overview, results plots.

deep-research.line: Research a topic across many sources and write a long narrative report.

last30days.line: What people said about a topic in the last 30 days on Reddit, X, YouTube, HN.

paper-fit.line: Find the right research paper for an assignment or project, then help read and apply it.

idea-evaluator.line: Judge whether a research idea is worth pursuing: novelty, feasibility, fatal flaws.

tech-paper-template.line: Plan a technical paper's logical skeleton before drafting.

benchmark-paper-template.line: Structure a benchmark or evaluation paper.

intro-drafter.line: Draft or restructure a paper's Introduction section.

paper-writer.line: Write paper sections or a full manuscript from the author's notes and results.

paper-polish.line: Polish existing academic prose: grammar, flow, tone, remove overclaiming.

humanizer.line: Rewrite text to remove AI-writing tells without changing facts.

pre-submission-reviewer.line: Full reviewer-style audit of a paper draft before submission.

vibe-research-workflow.line: Advice on using AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) across a research workflow.

p2-task.line: Run one Paper 2 task brief by ID (T0 to T9).

lecture-study-notebook.line: Study a course from lecture notes or slides, explained in Vietnamese, in a tabbed HTML notebook.

job-application-assistant.line: Job hunting: evaluate a posting, tailor CV, write cover letter, find new postings.

interview-coach.line: Interview practice: mock interviews, answer feedback, story bank.

prompt-master.line: Write or improve a prompt for another AI tool (LLM, Cursor, Midjourney, agents).

skill-creator.line: Create, edit or evaluate a skill (saved instructions for Claude).

writing-skills.line: Write a new skill test-first (TDD for process docs).

cowork-plugin.line: Create a new plugin or customize an installed one.

setup-claude.line: Guided first-time setup of Claude: role, plugins, connectors.

explain-usage.line: Explain where this session's tokens went.

import-memory.line: Import a memory export from another AI assistant.

coding-agent-quick-start.line: Tutorial on agent memory for coding agents.

memory-management.line: Set up a CLAUDE.md working memory that decodes shorthand and internal terms.

productivity-start.line: First-time setup of the productivity system and task dashboard.

task-management.line: Add, complete or list tasks in a shared TASKS.md file.

productivity-update.line: Sync tasks from project trackers, chat and email into TASKS.md.

morning.line: Run or schedule the user's morning brief.

chrome-browser.line: Websites in the user's own Google Chrome, only when they name Chrome or the Chrome extension.

built-in-browser.line: Default for any website task (open a site, check a portal, fill a form, 'use your browser'): the desktop app's built-in browser.

computer-use.line: Operate desktop apps on the user's computer by screenshots and clicks.
